forms.label: HOA & Condo Association Quote
forms.heading: Community Association Insurance Application
forms.subheading: Property, general liability, and directors & officers coverage for Oklahoma associations
forms.basedOn: USLI Community Association Package Product Application (CAP PKG 02/23)

confirmation.heading: Application Received
confirmation.body: Thanks — a licensed commercial agent will review the application and follow up, typically the same business day. If you reported losses, please email loss runs to info@okcinsurancebrokers.com so we can submit to markets right away.

fields.text: This application follows the USLI Community Association Package application (CAP PKG 02/23). Answer what you can — we'll follow up on anything left blank before submitting to markets.

fields.name: currentCarrier
fields.label: Does the association have current coverage?

fields.name: priorCancellation
fields.label: Has any insurance policy in the name of the association ever been canceled or non-renewed?

fields.name: mailingSameAsLocation
fields.label: Is the mailing address the same as the location address?

fields.name: propertyManagerMailing
fields.label: Mailing address for property manager
fields.placeholder: Same as mailing address if blank

steps.title: Units & Occupancy
steps.intro: General liability rating information — questions 1 through 14 and 22 through 24 of the carrier application.

fields.name: hasBylaws
fields.label: Does the association have active bylaws and Covenants, Conditions and Rules (CC&Rs) in place?

fields.name: exteriorResponsibility
fields.label: Who is responsible for insurance and maintenance of the exterior of residential buildings?

fields.name: bylawsInsureInteriors
fields.label: Do the bylaws require the association to insure any unit's interior property?

fields.name: unitsWhenComplete
fields.label: Total units when construction is complete

fields.name: commercialBusinessType
fields.label: Type of business occupying those units

fields.name: studentTenantPercent
fields.label: Percentage of units occupied by student tenants

fields.name: unitsRented
fields.label: Are any units rented or leased by the association or by individual unit owners?

fields.name: rentedPercent
fields.label: What percentage of units are rented or leased?

fields.name: majorityRented
fields.label: Are more than 50% of the units rented or leased?

fields.name: shortTermRentals
fields.label: Are there any short-term rentals (less than 30 days)?

fields.name: bylawsProhibitShortTerm
fields.label: Do the bylaws specifically prohibit short-term rentals?

fields.name: bylawsProhibitUnder25
fields.label: Do the bylaws prohibit short-term rentals to persons 25 years of age or younger?

fields.name: developerOnBoard
fields.label: Does the builder/developer or agent maintain representation on the board?

fields.name: boardControlTurnedOver
fields.label: Has control of the board been turned over to the association?

fields.name: unitsMajorityOccupied
fields.label: Are 50% or more of the units occupied?

fields.name: bylawsRequireMembership
fields.label: Do the written bylaws require all property owners to become members of the association?

fields.name: ageRestriction
fields.label: Do the bylaws include an age restriction for membership?

steps.title: Safety & Eligibility
steps.intro: Questions 17, 18, 21, and 25 through 35 of the carrier application.

fields.name: safetyHazardChecks
fields.label: Are safety hazard checks completed regularly on all common areas (stairways, sidewalks, driveways, parking, trees, docks, ramps), with repairs completed promptly?

fields.name: snowRemoval
fields.label: If exposed to snow and ice, is a responsible party required to clear all sidewalks, walkways and parking areas after the final snowfall and apply a deicing agent?

fields.name: smokeDetectorsAll
fields.label: Are there functioning smoke and/or heat detectors in all residential structures and clubhouses?

fields.name: enclosedStairwell
fields.label: If over three stories, is there a fully enclosed, fire-protected stairwell?

fields.name: fullySprinklered
fields.label: If over seven stories, is the building 100% sprinklered?

fields.name: contractorCOIs
fields.label: Does the association obtain certificates of general liability and workers' compensation coverage from all contractors?

fields.name: securityGuardService
fields.label: Does the association use a security guard service or other personnel to monitor the premises?

fields.name: foreclosuresBankruptcies
fields.label: Any past, pending or planned foreclosures, bankruptcies, or judgments for unpaid taxes against the association or an officer within the past five years?

fields.name: ongoingConstruction
fields.label: Are there plans for or ongoing construction/development of homes, units, common facilities or undeveloped lots?

fields.name: ongoingConstructionExplain
fields.label: Please explain
fields.placeholder: Scope, timeline, and who is performing the work

fields.name: hazardousAffiliations
fields.label: Does the association own, maintain, contract for, or affiliate with any of: airports/airstrips, animal stables, bridges for vehicle use, day cares, skiing/resort activities, electricity or sewage treatment facilities?

fields.name: sponsorsAthletics
fields.label: Does the association sponsor athletic teams or hold sporting competitions on premises?

fields.name: masterAssociation
fields.label: Is this a master association that oversees other sub-associations?

fields.name: subAssociationsInsured
fields.label: Are all sub-associations required to carry their own insurance and consist of only residential units?

fields.name: nonMembersUseFacilities
fields.label: Does the association allow non-members to use recreational facilities (pool, fitness, clubhouse)?

fields.name: sharedAmenities
fields.label: Does the association share any amenities with another association?

steps.title: Amenities
steps.intro: Questions 36 and 37 of the carrier application. Answer the sub-questions for amenities the association owns or maintains.

fields.name: hotelStyleAmenities
fields.label: Does the association offer valet parking, concierge service, or any hotel-style amenities?

fields.name: ownsAmenities
fields.label: Does the association own or maintain any amenities?

fields.name: poolCount
fields.label: Number of pools (multiple pools/Jacuzzis inside one fenced area count as one)

fields.name: poolVGBCompliant
fields.label: Does the pool comply with the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act?

fields.name: poolSafetyCompliance
fields.label: Are all pools completely fenced with a self-latching gate, depths clearly marked, rules posted, life safety equipment available, and no diving boards or slides?

fields.name: dockAccessFee
fields.label: Is there a charge or fee for access to the pier?

fields.name: ownsWatercraft
fields.label: Does the association own or rent any watercraft?

fields.name: noSwimmingSigns
fields.label: Are "No Swimming" signs posted on all docks, boat slips, boat ramps and piers?

fields.name: commercialVessels
fields.label: Are any commercial operations or docking of commercial vessels permitted?

fields.name: marinaServices
fields.label: Are any marina services provided (fueling, dry storage/moorage, repairs, sales)?

fields.name: swimAreaMarked
fields.label: If there is motorized boating activity, are buoys or signs marking the designated swimming area?

fields.name: clubhouseSquareFeet
fields.label: Clubhouse / cabana / guard house square footage

fields.name: clubhouseWiringSafe
fields.label: In association-owned common buildings, is all wiring on functioning circuit breakers, the building fully protected by functioning smoke detectors, with no aluminum or knob-and-tube wiring?

fields.name: fitnessSupervisionRules
fields.label: Are rules posted requiring adult supervision?

steps.title: Property Eligibility
steps.intro: Complete if the association owns a building. Questions 38 through 49 of the carrier application.

fields.name: windHailDeductible
fields.label: Wind / hail deductible (Oklahoma)
fields.help: Oklahoma associations usually carry a percentage wind/hail deductible. We'll show the dollar impact of each option alongside the quotes.

fields.text: Scheduled property limits — fill in a limit for anything the association needs insured. Leave the rest blank.

fields.name: limitPavedSurfaces
fields.label: Paved surfaces, sports courts, parking lots

fields.name: wiringOnBreakers
fields.label: For any building built prior to 1978, is 100% of the wiring on functional circuit breakers?

fields.name: aluminumKnobTube
fields.label: Does any building built prior to 1978 have aluminum wire or knob-and-tube wiring?

fields.name: detectorsAllUnits
fields.label: Do all public areas, occupancies and habitational units have functional smoke and/or heat detectors?

fields.name: commercialCooking
fields.label: Is there any commercial cooking (deep fryer, open flame grill, or wok) in any building?

fields.name: cookingSuppression
fields.label: Is there a functioning extinguishing system over the cooking equipment?

fields.name: kitchenNFPA96
fields.label: Does the kitchen meet all NFPA 96 requirements?

fields.name: cleaningContract
fields.label: Is there a cleaning contract in force with an outside firm?

steps.title: Directors & Officers
steps.intro: Questions 50 through 59 of the carrier application.

fields.name: percentUnitsSold
fields.label: What percent of the units are sold?

fields.name: vacationRentals
fields.label: Are any units short-term or vacation rentals?

fields.name: golfCourse
fields.label: Does the association own, maintain or have an affiliation with a golf course or country club?

fields.name: golfSeparateBoard
fields.label: Does the golf/country club have a separate board or separate management?

fields.name: waterTreatmentFacility
fields.label: Does the association own, maintain or have an affiliation with a water treatment facility?

fields.name: airportSewageFacility
fields.label: Does the association own, maintain or have an affiliation with an airport/airstrip or sewage treatment facility?

fields.name: negativeFundBalance
fields.label: Does the association have a negative fund balance?

fields.name: multipleUnitOwner
fields.label: Does any one person or entity own multiple units?

fields.name: greatestOwnershipPercent
fields.label: Greatest percentage of units owned by one person/entity

fields.text: Within the past 24 months, has any of the following occurred?

fields.name: foreclosureSale
fields.label: Has the association completed a foreclosure sale against an owner?

fields.name: electionChallenges
fields.label: Have there been any challenges to board elections, covenants, or bylaws?

fields.name: boardLitigation
fields.label: Has the board initiated litigation for reasons other than collection of dues or fees?

fields.name: priorDOClaims
fields.label: Within the past five years, has any inquiry, complaint, notice of hearing, claim or suit been made against the association or anyone proposed for insurance as a director, officer, trustee, employee or volunteer?

fields.name: awareOfCircumstances
fields.label: Is anyone proposed for this insurance aware of any fact, circumstance or situation that may result in a claim?

fields.name: doClaimDetails
fields.label: Describe the claim(s) or circumstance(s)
fields.placeholder: Type of claim (breach of contract, breach of fiduciary duty, CC&R violation, employment practices), date, status, and amounts involved. A USLI Claim Supplement is required for each claim.

fields.name: doPolicyCancelled
fields.label: Has any directors and officers or employment practices liability policy ever been canceled or non-renewed?

steps.title: Loss Information
steps.intro: Question 19 of the carrier application. Include all third-party property damage claims the association was responsible for.

fields.name: lossesPast5Years
fields.label: Any losses, claims or known circumstances that could result in a claim in the past five years (including closed without payment)?

fields.name: additionalLosses
fields.label: Additional losses
fields.placeholder: One per line: coverage type, date, description, paid, reserved, open/closed

fields.name: lossPreventionMeasures
fields.label: Measures put in place to prevent future incidents

fields.text: Carriers require loss runs for the past five years. Email them to info@okcinsurancebrokers.com and we'll attach them to the submission.

steps.title: Contact & Signature
steps.intro: A licensed commercial agent will follow up with association options, usually the same business day.

fields.name: contactTitle
fields.label: Title
fields.help: The application must be signed by an officer of the board or the property manager.

fields.name: heardAboutUs
fields.label: How did you hear about us?

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Anything else we should know?
fields.placeholder: Upcoming projects, special assessments, lender requirements, renewal deadlines

fields.text: Oklahoma fraud statement: WARNING — Any person who knowingly, and with intent to injure, defraud or deceive any insurer, makes any claim for the proceeds of an insurance policy containing any false, incomplete or misleading information is guilty of a felony.

fields.name: acknowledgement
fields.label: Do you confirm the information provided is true and correct, and understand it is material to the carrier's acceptance of the risk?

fields.text: This intake feeds the carrier application; a signature is collected on the carrier's form before binding. By submitting, you agree to be contacted by OKC Insurance Brokers. We never sell your information.
